Burgle Supply Company may start off slow and hard to figure out but once you get the hang of it and a friend or two it becomes a blast. Each mission starts you off in the warehouse where you choose your mask and choose these carefully because they give you benefits! You get to watch a fun little projector movie about the mechanics of the game and change your wardrobe. It is in here that you can also upgrade the hideout and your van. That's the most important part of this game. How much can your van hold? Keep an eye on that weight limit and decide is that heavy item worth it or the small high valued objects? This is what makes it a great or bad haul. The challenge of everyone staying alive is also fun because if someone dies, well they don't get the share of the loot. Only alive participants get their half. Figuring out how to get objects in and out of door ways can be a fun puzzle when enemies are after you. Overall I really enjoy this game. The only drawback is that I wish the enemies didn't feel generic.
